A dashed helper from B reaches C on the ray from A, making the path-difference triangle. Rays change direction at the lens and meet at a point on the vertical screen on the right.
figures.explanatoryUse: Explain normal incidence, corresponding slit points, repeat spacing d, outgoing angle measured from the normal, AC path difference and its right-triangle sine projection, then same-direction focusing at the screen.
